como puedo hacer para reutilizar el componente de createedit y que me muestre los datos del usuario que quiero editar? y en caso de que sea uno nuevo, el formulario este vacio. next-bound-frontend/src/app/administration/components/adm-user/user-table-list ```html next-bound-frontend/src/app/administration/components/adm-user/user-table-list/user-table-list.component.html
Username First name Last name id {{ user.username }} {{ user.firstName }} {{ user.lastName }} No customers found.
``` ```ts next-bound-frontend/src/app/administration/components/adm-user/user-table-list/user-table-list.component.ts import { FormsModule } from "@angular/forms"; import { CommonModule } from "@angular/common"; import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, input, } from "@angular/core"; import { TagModule } from "primeng/tag"; import { TableModule } from "primeng/table"; import { DropdownModule } from "primeng/dropdown"; import { IconFieldModule } from "primeng/iconfield"; import { InputIconModule } from "primeng/inputicon"; import { InputTextModule } from "primeng/inputtext"; import { MultiSelectModule } from "primeng/multiselect"; import { User, userStore } from "@app/store/userStore"; import { CreateEditUserDialogComponent } from "../create-edit-user-dialog/create-edit-user-dialog.component"; const primengModules = [ TagModule, TableModule, IconFieldModule, InputIconModule, InputTextModule, MultiSelectModule, DropdownModule, ]; @Component({ selector: "app-user-table-list", standalone: true, imports: [ ...primengModules, FormsModule, CommonModule, CreateEditUserDialogComponent, ], templateUrl: "./user-table-list.component.html", styleUrl: "./user-table-list.component.css", changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, }) export class UserTableListComponent { public readonly store = inject(userStore); loading = input.required(); users = input.required(); statuses!: any[]; updateUser(user: User) { console.log("update user", user); } deleteUser(user: User) {} ngOnInit() { this.statuses = [ { label: "Unqualified", value: "unqualified" }, { label: "Qualified", value: "qualified" }, { label: "New", value: "new" }, { label: "Negotiation", value: "negotiation" }, { label: "Renewal", value: "renewal" }, { label: "Proposal", value: "proposal" }, ]; } getSeverity(status: string) { switch (status) { case "unqualified": return "danger"; case "qualified": return "success"; case "new": return "info"; case "negotiation": return "warning"; case "renewal": return null; default: return null; } } } ``` ```ts next-bound-frontend/src/app/administration/components/adm-user/create-edit-user-dialog/create-edit-user-dialog.component.ts import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, input, } from "@angular/core"; import { ButtonModule } from "primeng/button"; import { DialogModule } from "primeng/dialog"; import { InputTextModule } from "primeng/inputtext"; import { FormsModule } from "@angular/forms"; import { User, userStore } from "@app/store/userStore"; const primengModules = [ButtonModule, DialogModule, InputTextModule]; @Component({ selector: "app-create-edit-user-dialog", standalone: true, imports: [...primengModules, FormsModule], templateUrl: "./create-edit-user-dialog.component.html", styleUrl: "./create-edit-user-dialog.component.css", changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, }) export class CreateEditUserDialogComponent { userStore = inject(userStore); user = input.required(); visible = false; hideDialog() { this.visible = false; } addUser() { const newUser: Omit = { id: -1, firstName: "John", lastName: "Doe", username: "johndoe3", password: "password", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; this.userStore.addUser(newUser); } } ``` ```html next-bound-frontend/src/app/administration/components/adm-user/create-edit-user-dialog/create-edit-user-dialog.component.html
{{ user().id ? "Update your information." : "Enter new user information." }}
``` Para reutilizar el componente `CreateEditUserDialogComponent` y que muestre los datos del usuario que quieres editar o un formulario vacío en caso de que sea un nuevo usuario, puedes seguir estos pasos: 1. **Modificar el componente `CreateEditUserDialogComponent` para aceptar un usuario como entrada y manejar la visibilidad del diálogo:** ```ts import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, Input, Output, EventEmitter } from "@angular/core"; import { ButtonModule } from "primeng/button"; import { DialogModule } from "primeng/dialog"; import { InputTextModule } from "primeng/inputtext"; import { FormsModule } from "@angular/forms"; import { User, userStore } from "@app/store/userStore"; const primengModules = [ButtonModule, DialogModule, InputTextModule]; @Component({ selector: "app-create-edit-user-dialog", standalone: true, imports: [...primengModules, FormsModule], templateUrl: "./create-edit-user-dialog.component.html", styleUrl: "./create-edit-user-dialog.component.css", changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, }) export class CreateEditUserDialogComponent { userStore = inject(userStore); @Input() user: User = { id: 0, firstName: '', lastName: '', username: '', password: '', createdAt: '' }; @Input() visible = false; @Output() visibleChange = new EventEmitter(); hideDialog() { this.visible = false; this.visibleChange.emit(this.visible); } saveUser() { if (this.user.id) { this.userStore.updateUser(this.user); } else { const newUser: Omit = { ...this.user, id: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000), // Generate a random ID for new user createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; this.userStore.addUser(newUser); } this.hideDialog(); } } ``` 2. **Actualizar el HTML del componente `CreateEditUserDialogComponent` para usar el método `saveUser` en lugar de `addUser`:** ```html
{{ user.id ? "Update your information." : "Enter new user information." }}
``` 3. **Modificar el componente `UserTableListComponent` para manejar la apertura del diálogo con los datos del usuario seleccionado o un nuevo usuario:** ```ts import { FormsModule } from "@angular/forms"; import { CommonModule } from "@angular/common"; import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, Input, ViewChild, } from "@angular/core"; import { TagModule } from "primeng/tag"; import { TableModule } from "primeng/table"; import { DropdownModule } from "primeng/dropdown"; import { IconFieldModule } from "primeng/iconfield"; import { InputIconModule } from "primeng/inputicon"; import { InputTextModule } from "primeng/inputtext"; import { MultiSelectModule } from "primeng/multiselect"; import { User, userStore } from "@app/store/userStore"; import { CreateEditUserDialogComponent } from "../create-edit-user-dialog/create-edit-user-dialog.component"; const primengModules = [ TagModule, TableModule, IconFieldModule, InputIconModule, InputTextModule, MultiSelectModule, DropdownModule, ]; @Component({ selector: "app-user-table-list", standalone: true, imports: [ ...primengModules, FormsModule, CommonModule, CreateEditUserDialogComponent, ], templateUrl: "./user-table-list.component.html", styleUrl: "./user-table-list.component.css", changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, }) export class UserTableListComponent { public readonly store = inject(userStore); @Input() loading!: boolean; @Input() users!: User[]; statuses!: any[]; @ViewChild(CreateEditUserDialogComponent) createEditUserDialog!: CreateEditUserDialogComponent; updateUser(user: User) { this.createEditUserDialog.user = { ...user }; this.createEditUserDialog.visible = true; } createUser() { this.createEditUserDialog.user = { id: 0, firstName: '', lastName: '', username: '', password: '', createdAt: '' }; this.createEditUserDialog.visible = true; } deleteUser(user: User) {} ngOnInit() { this.statuses = [ { label: "Unqualified", value: "unqualified" }, { label: "Qualified", value: "qualified" }, { label: "New", value: "new" }, { label: "Negotiation", value: "negotiation" }, { label: "Renewal", value: "renewal" }, { label: "Proposal", value: "proposal" }, ]; } getSeverity(status: string) { switch (status) { case "unqualified": return "danger"; case "qualified": return "success"; case "new": return "info"; case "negotiation": return "warning"; case "renewal": return null; default: return null; } } } ``` 4. **Actualizar el HTML del componente `UserTableListComponent` para agregar un botón de creación de usuario y manejar la visibilidad del diálogo:** ```html
Username First name Last name id {{ user.username }} {{ user.firstName }} {{ user.lastName }} No customers found.
``` Con estos cambios, el componente `CreateEditUserDialogComponent` se reutiliza para crear y editar usuarios. Cuando se hace clic en el botón de edición, se pasa el usuario seleccionado al diálogo, y cuando se hace clic en el botón de creación, se pasa un nuevo usuario vacío.
